name: desktop
description: Offline-first spaced repetition and AI-assisted learning desktop client.
author: Recall Project

scripts.dist:linux: node ../web/scripts/prepare-ocr-assets.mjs desktop && electron-vite build && electron-builder --linux AppImage --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: node ../web/scripts/prepare-ocr-assets.mjs desktop && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --x64 --publish never -c.mac.identity=null
scripts.dist:mac:arm64: node ../web/scripts/prepare-ocr-assets.mjs desktop && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --arm64 --publish never -c.mac.identity=null
scripts.dist:windows: node ../web/scripts/prepare-ocr-assets.mjs desktop && electron-vite build && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:mac:signed: node ../web/scripts/prepare-ocr-assets.mjs desktop && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --x64 --publish never -c.forceCodeSigning=true -c.mac.hardenedRuntime=true -c.mac.notarize=true
scripts.dist:mac:arm64:signed: node ../web/scripts/prepare-ocr-assets.mjs desktop && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --arm64 --publish never -c.forceCodeSigning=true -c.mac.hardenedRuntime=true -c.mac.notarize=true
scripts.dist:windows:signed: node ../web/scripts/prepare-ocr-assets.mjs desktop && electron-vite build && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never -c.forceCodeSigning=true -c.win.signExecutable=true
